strings.en: If I can corner that enemy...!
I can see it... the enemy's movements...!
With this, I can do it...!
So you insist on fighting just for fun...!
From this position, I can get Al-Van...!
I won't let you have your way/　with Earth or the Fury!
I'll end this battle... right here!
It's hard to believe they made contact/　for no reason at all...!
The Balshem series... Their objective is...!
You'll clear the way to Rabulpaila for us!
Gomoudokka... Did you come here/　just to show off your power?
What she's looking at/　isn't Gadisword's future...!
Do you really think you can/　fully control the Cross Gate?!
I can't let that appearance fool me...!
I won't let you have your way, Debudedabide!
That Zovorg unit is possessed too.
The thing possessing that unit is...!
I have to rescue the pilot...!
Controlling Zovorg units won't change a thing!
I'll stop Skull Knight in its tracks!
If it's a Dark Brain remnant,/　I can't let my guard down!
Whatever you are,/　I won't sit quietly and be destroyed!
I won't allow Golaikunru to interfere!
No matter how many times you come to Earth!
Now that I know its range is wide...!
I'll take care of that one!
If I focus my aim, even a Zeranio-class...!
I'll take on that Thick Cylinder!
White Horn locked! Here I go!
I have to eliminate the Lamaris quickly...!
I won't let the Lamaris do as they please!
They're fusing...?/　All the more reason I can't ignore them!
I can't let those thoughts swallow me...!
I have to watch out for those tentacles...!
I can't let this pressure swallow me...!
To think it could grow that large...!
I need to create an opening...!
Time to pay you back for earlier!
Where are you looking!? Here I come!!
I can't afford... to lose heart now!
I can't flinch at something like that...!
Aaugh!/　They're pushing me back this far...!
N-no way...! It pierced my armor!
If I gave up in a place like this.../　Ryu and Rai would laugh at me...!
Ngh! I'll turn this around somehow!
!/　If the T-LINK System is intact,/　I can still manage this!
If it weren't for the Plus Parts.../　I'd have been done for!?
Ngh! I won't give in to the backlash!
So what if I lose a connector or two!
Ngh! This is no time to black out!
Ngh, that power.../　I'll shatter it, Gu-Landon!!
Limitless energy.../　How can I break through it...?!
I-I have to stop XN-L here...!
I can't let that hatred spread...!
I have to annihilate the Ida type...!
Aah!/　I-I guess I slipped up a little!
It's okay, it's not a fatal wound yet!
Nice choice of target, but.../　this won't bring me down!
Ngh...!/　They're focusing their attacks on me...?
The Powered can still take this much.
The added weight means added durability!
I'm not wearing the SRX's/　legs just for show!
Kyaah!/　I need to focus my mind more...!
...! No system errors.../　I can still go!
Ngh...!/　I can't let this disturb my mind...!
This won't be enough to shake my mind!
That's not enough to take me down, Jua-Mu!
So that's the power of the Emperor Unit...!
Reggiane lured me into her range...!
It moves more nimbly than it looks...!
Skull Knight... Faster than I expected...!
Ngh! I have to read/　XN-L's movements precisely...!
Hey! Is that any way to treat a lady!?
Do you really think/　this is enough to beat me?
This is sloppy.../　I'm supposed to be the leader...
No good. I need to sharpen my senses.
That's not enough to bring down my R-3!
Ngh...!/　I need to focus and read their moves...!
No good.../　I have to feel the enemy's presence...!
Ngh! Is the link level too low...!?
The enemy's movements.../　I must read them more precisely.
Stay calm... Predict the enemy's moves.
Did you think you could overpower me, Gu-Landon?!
The Floraga's own performance/　can't be ignored either...!
Such precise aim from that giant body...!
An attack like this is nothing!
Don't take me lightly just because/　I'm a woman!
I won't be so easy to hit, you know?
Something like this.../　I don't even need the T-LINK System!
Sorry, but you won't hit me.
I may not look it, but/　I'm the leader of the SRX Team!
I can see it all from here!
I can sense the enemy's mind.../　their intent to attack...!
Just as I thought, you came from there.
I have to do my best, for Mai's sake!
Did you think you could hit the Gunner?!
I knew you'd come at me that way, Karo-Ran!
Gu-Landon, power alone can't rule people!
You should know what we're capable of, Gomoudokka!
I won't be hit that easily, Reggiane!
I can't let the Lamaris sink their teeth into me.
I can't spend time on a Kaana!
Oh? It's pointless if you can't hit me.
...! Th-That one was a little too close...
...! I dodged it...!/　The system link is holding up well.
They aren't worried about their energy reserves...!
XN-L, your attacks won't reach me!
Don't think that was the end of it!
Ryu!/　Let's go with our usual formation!
Ryu, I'm starting a Cooperative Attack!
Nice work, Rai! With this timing...!
Rai!/　Let's go with our usual formation!
Radha, leave the rest to me!
Lüne, you take the other enemies!
Lieutenant, leave the rest to me!
Excellen, leave the rest to me!
Working with the captain, we can do it!
Mai, leave the rest to me!
You and me... we can do this!
Honestly, that girl.../　She's just like Ryu that way.
Arieil, leave the rest to me!
Josh, I'll take it from here!
Aqua, leave the rest to me!
Calvina, leave the rest to me!
Worship your big sister, Deadpan Boobs.
Mind if I spill all your secrets? Red Seaweed.
Mind if I tug on them from both sides?/　Those black panties.
Is that all this Bang-Bang Kaiser can do?
I can at least buy us some time!
Let me act like a leader for once!
Rai, I can't keep relying on you...!
Lieutenant Lamia, leave the rest to me!
Let's finish this in one go!
Bunched up like that, you're easy targets!
You two, we're going with R-Formation!
Will of destruction... become my blade!!
I trained in close combat too, you know!
I'll land this hit no matter what!
Take this strike from the heavens!!
The Boxer's power is still going strong...
I'll try out the Knight Foul!
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
For a High-Leg, impossible is nothin'!
Where do you think you're looking?!
